note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 5 June 1958. The returning officer's notice of result (Eleanor Hollinger, returning officer, dated 6 June 1958) lists all 23 district electoral divisions: polls in Galgorm and Portglenone, 18 sole candidates declared elected, and in Glenwherry, Lisnagarron and Newtowncrommelin the retiring members deemed to be re-elected. No party labels are printed. Sole candidate, entered in the notice as elected with no votes recorded. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballyconnolly' to Ballyconnelly (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Ballymena Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ballyconnelly; the rounds were filed as Ballyconnelly (1924); Ballyconnolly (1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967). This round was filed as 'Ballyconnolly', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ballyconnolly) answers with a redirect to this one.
